newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jet Services launches intercontinental express.
newsitem.headline: Jet Services launches intercontinental express.

text.p: French road and air express distribution company, Jet Services, said it has launched a worldwide express service named, "Intercontinental".
The new service was very competitive in terms of delivery times and rates and would be in direct competition with services offered by the integrators, Jet Services said in a statement.
The French operator is forecasting a volume of traffic for "Intercontinental" of 1,000 shipments a day by the end of 1996, the company added.
Jet Services launched Intercontinental in close co-operation with another express operator whose identity had not been disclosed.
To date, Jet Services international activities have largely centred on intra-European express via its subsidiary companies Axor and the Air Jet airline.
Last month, Axor launched freighter routes between Coventry and Paris/Charles de Gaulle with a SD300 aircraft and between Kassel,Germany and CDG using Metroliner aircraft.
This was part of a strategy to extend the distribution network of Axor's "next-day" express service which had previously been limited to France, the Benelux and Germany.

Axor, which also operates a Liege-CDG freighter route, is poised to extend its European network to Switzerland, Italy and Spain later this month, Jet Services added. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
